sql.dataView.getAllForCompany: select * from flow.data_view where company_id = :companyId and archived is false
sql.dataView.getOne: select dv.*, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(fields))) FROM ( select dvfc.id, fc.id as "fieldConfigId", fc.default_field_id as "defaultFieldId", fc.custom_field_group_assignment_id as "customFieldGroupAssignmentId", fc.process_step_event_id as "processStepEventId", fc.field_to_update as "fieldToUpdate", fc.archived from flow.data_view_field_config dvfc inner join flow.field_config fc on dvfc.field_config_id = fc.id where fc.archived is false and dvfc.archived is false and dvfc.data_view_id = dv.id ) fields), '[]') AS "dataViewFieldConfigs" from flow.data_view dv where dv.id = :viewId and dv.company_id = :companyId
